caveats:
The map is derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images acquired by the ALOS-2 satellites operated by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA).

These are preliminary maps derived from satellite radar and should be used as guidance only. Coloured pixels may include false positives, and their absence does not mean an absence of damage or flooding.
methodology_other: Change detection on synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images acquired before and after the event. Damage Proxy Maps show significant changes in radar coherence and amplitude; Flood Proxy Maps show areas that changed to standing water. Maps are preliminary and checked against news reports and ground-level imagery where available.

# Indonesia Semeru Volcano: Damage Proxy Maps, Dec 2021

The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Indonesia Semeru Volcano (Dec 2021) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it.

organization.description: The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) is a research lab at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. It uses satellite remote sensing, mainly synthetic aperture radar (SAR), to map natural hazards and disasters. The lab produces Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) and Flood Proxy Maps (FPMs) showing where damage or flooding has likely occurred. Its work focuses on Southeast Asia and the wider Asia-Pacific, and it also responds to major disasters worldwide.

resources.description:
EOS-RS Pyroclastic flow extent map: Indonesia, Semeru volcano, 5 Dec 2021, v0.4

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT, Shapefile.

This preliminary map shows areas that are likely affected by pyroclastic flows (shown by orange pixels of 25 m in size) in Eastern Java, Indonesia due to the eruption at Semeru volcano starting on 4 Dec 2021. It is validated using ground observations at Gladak Perak Bridge. The map extent is indicated by the white polygon. This map should be used as a guidance to identify areas that are likely affected, and is less reliable over urban and vegetated areas. This map may contain any changes caused by previous eruptions in 2020.

resources.description:
Peta kerusakan EOS-RS: Erupsi Gunung Semeru, Indonesia, Dec 2021, v0.9

ZIP containing: GeoTIFF, KMZ, PNG, TXT.

Peta ini menunjukkan sebaran wilayah yang kemungkinan mengalami kerusakan akibat awan panas dan lahar dari letusan Gunung Semeru pada tanggal 4 December 2021. Kerusakan ditunjukkan oleh setiap piksel yang berukuran 30 x 30 meter. Tingkat kerusakan ditunjukkan oleh piksel mulai dari warna kuning (kerusakan rendah/sedang) ke warna merah (kerusakan parah). Peta sebaran kerusakan ini telah tervalidasi menggunakan sebaran kerusakan yang dilaporkan oleh media cetak maupun televisi. Peta ini dapat dijadikan acuan untuk mengidentifikasi wilayah-wilayah yang mengalamai kerusakan. Untuk menjadi perhatian, hasil analisis ini memiliki tingkat kepercayaan tinggi apabila diakibatkan oleh kerusakan bangunan yang signifikan, kerusakan struktur bangunan yang berskala kecil atau sebagian tidak dapat terdeteksi. Sebaliknya, hasil analisis ini memiliki tingkat kepercayaan rendah di daerah yang banyak vegetasi. Oleh karena itu, sebaran piksel di daerah yang banyak vegetasi bisa saja tidak berasosiasi dengan kerusakan. Meskipun demikian, tidak adanya piksel di daerah vegetasi, bukan berarti tidak ada kerusakan. Analisis kerusakan di peta ini hanya mencakup area dalam kotak berwarna putih.Â
